newsitem.title: USA: Montgomery Hospital, Pa., in new alliance -- paper.
newsitem.headline: Montgomery Hospital, Pa., in new alliance -- paper.

text.p: Montgomery Hospital Medical Center said it would align with the Pittsburgh-based Allegheny Health, Education and Research Foundation, the Philadelphia Inquirer reported Wednesday.

The deal falls short of a merger, but ties the two together through joint business ventures, the newspaper said. Plans include four joint outpatient surgical-care centers and beefed-up cancer care at Montgomery Hospital.
Montgomery, located in Norristown, has pledged to direct patients to Allegheny hospitals when a referral is appropriate.
Allegheny has aggressively pursued the Philadelphia health care market, and now owns or controls 10 hospitals and more than 600 physician practices in the region.
